# 進延壽赤書表

**ID:** KR5c0274
**Custom ID:** ZB5c0265

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Memorial Submitting the Life-Prolonging Red Book*

by [裴鉉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A3%B4%E9%89%89) (Péi Xuàn) — Táng Zhōngnánshān Daoist

The Táng Daoist Péi Xuàn's **memorial submitting** the *Yán shòu chì shū* 延壽赤書 ("Red Book for Prolonging Life") to the throne. The memorial is preserved together with the scripture proper (see [KR5c0275](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0275)) as the "a" and "b" parts of **DZ 877**. Péi styles himself "Zhōngnánshān mountain-forest subject" (*Zhōngnán shān lín chén* 終南山林臣).

**Dating.** Táng. Dynasty: 唐.
